limit.hint: Leave empty for no limit. A check is a lesson's checkpoint, counted across all of its questions. Practice never counts.
wait: Wait after an attempt that did not pass (minutes)
wait.hint: 0 means learners can try again right away.
summary.unlimited: Learners can take as many graded attempts at each check as they need.
summary.limit: {count, plural, one {Learners get # graded attempt at each check.} other {Learners get # graded attempts at each check.}}
summary.wait: {minutes, plural, one {After an attempt that does not pass, they wait # minute before the next one.} other {After an attempt that does not pass, they wait # minutes before the next one.}}
summary.noWait: They can try again right after an attempt that does not pass.
summary.practice: Practice is never limited, results already recorded never change, and an administrator can allow one more attempt.
card.title: Graded attempts
card.empty: This course has no checks yet.
card.granted: {count, plural, one {# allowed by staff} other {# allowed by staff}}
grant.title: Allow one more attempt at {check}
grant.effect: The learner gets one more graded attempt at this check, and any wait there ends now. Their recorded answers and results do not change.
grant.reason.hint: Recorded with the change, for example: the connection dropped during the check.
grant.done: One more attempt allowed. The learner can start it now.
